transcript.text: And then I've seen you kill any chance you would have at becoming the face of this company.
I've seen you punt and put down a legend like Shawn Michaels, but then I've seen you kill
any opportunity you might have to be considered a professional. I've seen you punt and put down
my own father, but then I've seen you kill the chance at that big 15.
Look at your whole class from OVW, Randy. You're the last man standing. We're talking here.
So who am I in all of this? Because I must be the anomaly because you know,
I know, they all know, you punted me too. But the very next night after you punted me,
one of us walked out here in front of the paying customer with his head held high,
while the other nursed his wounds in St. Louis like a little bitch.
